source_description: The wine bottle with a narrow neck and wider body. For placement select its intended load-bearing base or body-side patch according to the useful posture chosen from current RGB.
receiver_description: The uppermost receiving support of the wooden wine rack, not the lower shelf or table.
relevant_visual_cues: Uppermost rack receiving patch, slat gaps and edges
Empty hand clear while bottle remains on the top support

stages.name: Align above bottle
stages.goal: Position the open hand above a graspable bottle section.
stages.exit: The actor-selected source surface is coarsely aligned with the finger gap in world X/Y (each reference difference within 10mm), and current RGB supports a suitable approach orientation. This is not contact proof.
perception_inputs: Current bottle mask and visible orientation
Finger gap in fixed and wrist RGB
Nearby rack, bowl and cabinet boundaries

control_contract.translation: Align horizontally for the selected grasp relationship. The selected source dot is a surface reference, not a grasp centre.
control_contract.height: Maintain suitable overhead clearance. Already being safely above is not a reason to rise further.
control_contract.exit: Horizontal alignment and approach orientation are suitable; continue to descent.

stages.name: Descend around bottle
stages.goal: Bring the fingers alongside the selected section.
stages.exit: The hand appears positioned for a closure attempt. Proven contact is not required.

control_contract.translation: Approach the visually selected grasp region. Preserve horizontal alignment and account for finger geometry.
control_contract.exit: The hand appears positioned for a closure attempt. Proven contact is not required.

stages.name: Close
stages.goal: Close the fingers around the bottle.
stages.exit: Closure was attempted. Continue if engagement looks plausible; retry alignment if clearly missed.

control_contract.translation: Hold position unless a visible positioning problem requires returning to alignment.
control_contract.gripper: Attempt closure; then inspect the result.
control_contract.exit: Closure was attempted. Continue if engagement looks plausible; retry alignment if clearly missed.

stages.name: Lift
stages.goal: Briefly test whether your selected visible bottle feature rises with the closed hand before beginning combined reorientation and approach.
stages.exit: The camera-derived selected feature rises at least20mm and its motion agrees with measured own translation within10mm per axis, with a valid same-origin RGB match. This is a provisional motion test, not a contact or holding certificate.

control_contract.translation: Briefly test visible bottle following and table separation; rack-approach clearance is a later task.
control_contract.exit: The camera-derived selected feature rises at least20mm and its motion agrees with measured own translation within10mm per axis, with a valid same-origin RGB match. This is a provisional motion test, not a contact or holding certificate.
control_contract.failure: If the source does not follow, reassess the grasp.

stages.name: Transport and choose useful posture
stages.goal: Which independent world-axis translations and rotations improve a clear approach to the top region while retaining the bottle?
stages.exit: The bottle is visibly over or approaching the top receiving region, with a plausible supported footprint and an unobstructed seating approach.
perception_inputs: Visible bottle extent, selected support feature, top receiving patch, obstacle clearances and current hand-to-bottle relationship.

control_contract.references: Actor-selected load-bearing bottle feature and uppermost rack support patch; no compulsory posture.
control_contract.translation: Which independent world-axis translations and rotations improve a clear approach to the top region while retaining the bottle?
control_contract.exit: The bottle is visibly over or approaching the top receiving region, with a plausible supported footprint and an unobstructed seating approach.

stages.name: Seat on the top support
stages.goal: Can the bottle be brought onto the top support without crossing an edge, entering a gap, colliding or requiring the fingers to carry it indefinitely?
stages.exit: Views support apparent seating on the top region with a plausible stable footprint and room to open the fingers. Contact and load transfer remain unconfirmed.
perception_inputs: Updated source-to-support offsets, estimated footprint overlap, support gaps and edges, finger clearance, and bottle motion across views.

control_contract.references: Actor-selected load-bearing bottle feature and uppermost rack support patch; no compulsory posture.
control_contract.translation: Can the bottle be brought onto the top support without crossing an edge, entering a gap, colliding or requiring the fingers to carry it indefinitely?
control_contract.exit: Views support apparent seating on the top region with a plausible stable footprint and room to open the fingers. Contact and load transfer remain unconfirmed.

stages.name: Release
stages.goal: Attempt opening at the selected top-support placement; observe actual disengagement and support in the next inspection phase.
stages.exit: An opening attempt actually executed; advance provisionally to clearance and support inspection.

control_contract.exit: An opening attempt actually executed; advance provisionally to clearance and support inspection.

stages.name: Clear the hand and inspect
stages.goal: Is the empty hand clear? Does the bottle remain on the upper receiving support, rather than on the table, lower shelf or in the fingers? Is continued sliding or rolling visible?
stages.exit: Success is supported only by repeated visible evidence of the bottle remaining on the top support with the empty hand clear. Occlusion or ambiguous support requires further inspection.
perception_inputs: A collision-free retreat view, visible empty fingers, and successive external views showing the bottle and both rack levels.

control_contract.references: Actor-selected load-bearing bottle feature and uppermost rack support patch; no compulsory posture.
control_contract.translation: Is the empty hand clear? Does the bottle remain on the upper receiving support, rather than on the table, lower shelf or in the fingers? Is continued sliding or rolling visible?
control_contract.exit: Success is supported only by repeated visible evidence of the bottle remaining on the top support with the empty hand clear. Occlusion or ambiguous support requires further inspection.

coarse_alignment_scope: Outer experimental adaptation: explicit XY feature-positioning semantics; source reference and orientation remain actor choices. A 10mm stopping band is a control heuristic, not measured sensor accuracy. Z and rotations have no algorithmic target error.
